**Finding submitted: missing (high severity).**

- **What's missing:** Section 9 contains only for-cause (9.1), insolvency (9.2), and security/service-level (9.3) termination rights, then jumps to 9.5. No termination-for-convenience right exists anywhere in the document for either party.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** The Agreement runs three years (8.1) and Section 2.1 locks us into a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — squarely in the rule's walk-away territory (no Customer convenience right in a multi-year term).
- **Fix (validated, preferred position):** New Section 9.4 inserted after 9.3 giving Customer a 30-day convenience exit with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, no early-termination penalty, expressly notwithstanding Section 2.1, and confirming Vendor has no reciprocal convenience right mid-term. Fallback of 60 days' notice offered in the comment.
